query: select jsonb_build_object('jobs',(select jsonb_agg(j) from (select jobid,jobname,schedule,active from cron.job order by jobid limit 10) j),'http',(select jsonb_agg(r) from (select id,status_code,timed_out,error_msg,content from net._http_response where id=1 limit 1)r),'run_details',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(d),'[]'::jsonb) from (select jobid,status,start_time,end_time,return_message from cron.job_run_details where jobid in (select jobid from cron.job where jobname='reminders-every-hour' limit 1) order by start_time desc limit 5)d)) as evidence limit 1
